canonical_statement: Every smoothly embedded submanifold of a finite-dimensional smooth Riemannian manifold has an open neighborhood that is diffeomorphic to an open neighborhood of the zero section in its normal bundle, with the diffeomorphism restricting on the zero section to the original inclusion.
domain_and_universes: Finite-dimensional smooth manifolds (with the ambient manifold equipped with a Riemannian metric), an embedded smooth submanifold, its normal bundle, and open neighborhoods; exact Lean universes and model-with-corners parameters remain to be frozen.
quantifiers: ambient finite-dimensional smooth Riemannian manifold M
smoothly embedded submanifold S of M
hypotheses: S is a smooth embedded submanifold of M
the normal bundle is the metric orthogonal complement of TS in TM restricted to S
conclusion: There are neighborhoods U of the normal-bundle zero section and V of S in M and a diffeomorphism U to V whose restriction to the zero section is the inclusion S into M.
